description: Static search of a VERIFIED Ethereum contract's Solidity source (Blockscout) for max-wallet, max-transaction and cooldown rules, with the matching lines. Unverified contracts are reported as such, not guessed. Bytecode-only and non-Ethereum chains are not covered; a hit is a clue, not proof of a trap. Related tools on this server, for a different need: agent_intel_whale_transaction_monitor when you need large transfers on Ethereum in the latest 1 to 10 blocks; agent_intel_bundle_sniper_detector when you need to look at the first Solana slot where a token mint appears. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: agent_intel_anti_whale_limit_detector
title: Static search of a VERIFIED Ethereum contract's Solidity
